name: coursecroll-webview
description: CourseScrollWebView — 马拉松/长赛道动画演示模板（three.js + SVG，4K 逐帧可复现）

scripts.fonts: uv run --with fonttools --with brotli python tools/fonts.py
scripts.data: uv run --with pymupdf --with shapely python tools/extract_map.py && uv run --with numpy python tools/build_course.py && uv run --with numpy --with shapely python tools/build_world.py
scripts.assets: uv run --with numpy --with pillow --with scipy python tools/cutout.py && uv run --with pillow python tools/pack_assets.py && uv run --with pillow python tools/pack_assets.py --h 720 --lmw 1280 --suffix _bible
scripts.preview: node tools/tts_edge.mjs && node tools/vo_encode.mjs && node tools/styles.mjs stage
scripts.seq: uv run --with requests python tools/gen_seq.py navi && uv run --with numpy --with pillow --with scipy python tools/slice_seq.py navi && uv run --with pillow python tools/pack_assets.py navi && node tools/styles.mjs seq
scripts.cardart: uv run --with requests --with pillow python tools/card_art.py
scripts.sfx: node tools/vo_encode.mjs && node tools/sfx_cues.mjs && uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with pillow python tools/sfx_render.py && uv run --with numpy --with scipy python tools/sfx_audit.py && uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with pillow python tools/sfx_sheet.py
scripts.docs: npm run subs && npm run board
scripts.stems: uv run --with numpy --with scipy python tools/verify_stems.py
scripts.bootstrap:
npm run assets && npm run timeline && npm run sfx && npm run preview && echo "
✓ bootstrap 完成，打开 dist/stage-B-导航地图.html"
